purpose: Public, no-auth announcement discovery only. Results are candidate records, never eligibility decisions or applications.
searchNote: A source with a search block queries the board's own index. A date-sorted list page only exposes its newest rows, so a board holding thousands of notices must be queried, not scraped page by page. `pages` widens the window where a board's posting rate can push a still-open notice off page one.
koccaCategoryNote: On KOCCA PIMS, an absent category is the open-programs view and category=4 is the 종료된사업 archive (2,115 notices on 2026-09-01). category=1 and category=2 return nothing, and category=3 mirrors the open view. The archive is the searchable history; the open view is the short live list.

sources.note: Watch only. On 2026-09-01 its board carried 영화 programmes exclusively and title searches for 인공지능, AI and 숏폼 returned nothing. Registered so a move into AI or series production is seen when it happens rather than found afterwards.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST)

excluded.name: e-Naradoum
excluded.reason: National subsidy application and execution system. This radar does not authenticate, submit, or collect applicant data. It is a procedural verification route after a human selects a notice.

excluded.name: KOCCA finance-support board (B0158960)
excluded.reason: Loan, guarantee, and content-valuation products. Eligibility turns on credit and collateral rather than competitive selection, so it does not belong in the same candidate stream as production-support calls.

excluded.name: MOEF (mofe.go.kr) and MCST portal main
excluded.reason: Budget, tax, and cross-sector ministry news. Content calls are executed through KOCCA and the MCST culture-support index already registered here.

excluded.name: KOTRA (대한무역투자진흥공사) direct board
excluded.reason: Its programs are published through Bizinfo, which is registered here, so a separate source would duplicate them. The programs themselves are trade fairs and export services rather than content production calls.

aggregatorNote: Bizinfo aggregates KOCCA, KOTRA, and the regional content agencies (부산정보산업진흥원, 세종테크노파크, 대구디지털혁신진흥원, 경기콘텐츠진흥원, 전남정보문화산업진흥원 and others). Registering it with a search covers those bodies without a source each. KOFIC does not feed it, and is excluded on its own grounds.
scopeNote: allRowsInScope marks a board whose every row is already a notice this radar wants - a content agency's own programme list. The discovery vocabulary is skipped there, because applying it subtracts real notices: WelCon lost 콘텐츠IP 마켓, ATF 애니메이션, KOMICS Thailand and the 론치패드 calls to it. A broad index (MCST, Bizinfo) keeps the vocabulary, because most of its rows belong to other sectors.
probeNote: A probe search widens the net into an adjacent board using words that are not themselves in scope (KOFIC's 첨단, 온라인, 시리즈); the discovery vocabulary still screens what comes back. A non-probe query names a topic, and every such word must exist in the vocabulary - a test enforces this, because querying for 만화 and then dropping the result for not saying 웹툰 loses exactly what was searched for.
queryReachNote: A searching source can only find what it queries: the filter vocabulary is the ceiling, not the reach. AI and IP were in the filter but not in any query list, so 순천시 글로벌 IP 창·제작 and 경기 AI 클러스터 SLUSH fell out of collection once Bizinfo moved from its front page to search - both titles carry AI or IP and none of the other query words. Adding a filter keyword is not enough; it has to be queried somewhere too.
